name.full: Agent Map for Copilot Studio agents

description.short: See how a Copilot Studio agent is built.
description.full: Agent Map shows an interactive map of a Copilot Studio agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot: its skills, tools, knowledge sources, connected agents, topics, triggers, and evaluation sets, and how they connect. The component reads Dataverse with your own delegated identity. It is read-only.
